description:
Sherry FitzGerald Davitt and Davitt are delighted to present this four-bedroom detached family home, presented in excellent condition and boasting many features including, an excellent B- BER rating, GFCH, PVC double glazed windows & door, front porch, side pedestrian access, cobble lock front driveway offering ample parking space and walled garden on an end site. Situated in a mature location within walking distance to the village of Longwood with all amenities both social and essential.

The accommodation consists of porch area with tiles and leads into the Entrance Hall with understairs storage, coving, laminate flooring and leading to the bright and spacious Living Room with laminate flooring, coving, bay window, fireplace with gas fire stove.  The open plan Kitchen/Dining/Living area has a fitted kitchen with ample storage units, tiled splash back and flooring, kitchen island with extra storage and seating area, two large Velux windows, large window and French doors to the rear offering so much natural light to the room. Off the kitchen is a guest Wc /Utility room with tiled flooring, counter work top and plumbed for washing machine. 

The first floor comprises of a spacious landing with carpet flooring giving access to all four bedrooms with timber flooring, ample storage in all rooms with slide robes and built in wardrobe and the Master Bedroom comes with fully tiled En-Suite. The main family bathroom is fully tiled with a three-piece suite.

Brackinrainey Wood is within walking distance of the village of Longwood and all its amenities such as shops, primary and secondary schools, sporting facilities, bus route. Nearby towns include Enfield, Trim, Kilcock, Maynooth, Enfield Train station is a short distance away etc. This property is finished to a very high standard and viewing is highly recommended
